input.out_of_range_behavior: invalid_input; never truncate, wrap, or clamp
input.serialized_input_policy: reject malformed values, booleans, and non-integer JSON values before calling the core
input.optional_byte_adapter: exactly two bytes, least significant byte first

source_obligations: For every w in Fin 65536: check(w) = true iff for every x,y in Fin 4, g_w(x) = g_w(y) implies g_w(f_w(x)) = g_w(f_w(y)).
Decoded fields agree with the specified bit positions.
Encoding the decoded fields returns the original word.
For every integer z, decoding returns invalid_input iff z < 0 or z >= 65536.

result_contract.applies_to: Future records with status evidenced_result. The specification_example fixtures below are incomplete placeholders, not admissible checked results.
result_contract.identity_rule: Bind claims to the exact encoded word and contract version, even when group labels define the same partition.
result_contract.hash_encoding: SHA-256 of the exact referenced artifact bytes, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits; no newline normalization or self-hashing contract field.
result_contract.outcome_semantics: For an evidenced valid input, preserves is a Boolean; violating_pair is null when true and an explicit pair when false. Invalid input is a separate boundary result. Checker/reference agreement is a separate run observation.
consistency_requirements: The input ID encodes the same word as input.word.
Decoded operation and group labels match input.word under this contract.
The claim names this exact input, specification version, and claim kind.
The specification ID, version, and artifact_sha256 match the selected contract artifact; recompute its hash from the exact bytes before accepting the record.
An outcome may be published only with evidence tied to the checker and this input.
A failed preservation claim includes a pair x,y with equal original labels and different output labels.
A false preservation outcome is distinct from checker/reference disagreement.
Full bounded coverage requires the distinct covered words to be exactly 0 through 65535, not only a total execution count of 65536.
Malformed-input adapter tests are recorded separately from the 16-bit word domain.
A passed executable comparison retains its bounded scope; it does not imply binary refinement.

limits: No checker or binary execution is evidenced by this fixture.
